title: Shakti Peetha Explorer
intro: There is no single agreed list of Shakti Peethas. The Puranic and tantric enumerations differ, and modern reference works differ again. This dataset records each site together with the list or lists that include it, the tradition that supports the attribution, and an explicit confidence level. Where sources disagree the disagreement is preserved. Coordinates are approximate map centroids, not survey data, and no temple website, darshan time or historical fact has been invented to fill a gap.

18.label: Ashtadasha Shakti Peetha
18.note: The 18-seat enumeration associated with the Ashtadasha Shakti Peetha Stuti. Recensions disagree about which seats belong to it and in what order, so it is presented as one tradition ordering rather than a fixed canon. The records here cover only part of the 18.

51.label: 51 Shakti Peethas
51.note: The most widely circulated enumeration, associated with the Pithanirnaya and related tantric lists.

52.label: 52 Shakti Peethas
52.note: A variant enumeration; some traditions count 52 seats.

regional.label: Regional / expanded
regional.note: Important Devi seats held sacred by a regional tradition but not consistently counted in the classical enumerations.
